raw.query: WITH comparable AS (SELECT DISTINCT window_name, forecast_model, numerator_worker_seconds, denominator_worker_seconds FROM provenance.v_cost_ratio WHERE is_current = TRUE AND experiment = 'g1' AND policy = 'forecast' AND lead_s = 30 AND forecast_model IN ('chronos','toto','timesfm') AND denominator_kind = 'deployable_static_c8' AND denominator_window_mismatch = FALSE), per_window AS (SELECT window_name AS scope, MAX(numerator_worker_seconds) FILTER (WHERE forecast_model='chronos') AS chronos_ws, MAX(numerator_worker_seconds) FILTER (WHERE forecast_model='toto') AS toto_ws, MAX(numerator_worker_seconds) FILTER (WHERE forecast_model='timesfm') AS timesfm_ws, MAX(denominator_worker_seconds) AS denominator_ws FROM comparable GROUP BY window_name), breakdown AS (SELECT scope, chronos_ws, toto_ws, timesfm_ws, denominator_ws, CASE WHEN chronos_ws = LEAST(chronos_ws,toto_ws,timesfm_ws) THEN 'chronos' WHEN toto_ws = LEAST(chronos_ws,toto_ws,timesfm_ws) THEN 'toto' ELSE 'timesfm' END AS cheapest FROM per_window UNION ALL SELECT 'all_comparable_windows', SUM(chronos_ws), SUM(toto_ws), SUM(timesfm_ws), SUM(denominator_ws), CASE WHEN SUM(chronos_ws) = LEAST(SUM(chronos_ws),SUM(toto_ws),SUM(timesfm_ws)) THEN 'chronos' WHEN SUM(toto_ws) = LEAST(SUM(chronos_ws),SUM(toto_ws),SUM(timesfm_ws)) THEN 'toto' ELSE 'timesfm' END FROM per_window) SELECT scope, chronos_ws, toto_ws, timesfm_ws, denominator_ws, cheapest FROM breakdown ORDER BY CASE scope WHEN 'burst2' THEN 1 WHEN 'burst6' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
raw.observed: Chronos is cheapest on burst2 (124293.4 worker-seconds versus Toto 125253.7), but Toto is cheapest on burst6 (85032.9 versus Chronos 88374.4) and across both comparable windows (210286.6 versus Chronos 212667.8).
raw.claimed: Chronos-2 is the cheapest forecaster because it has 120M parameters and Toto-2.0 is 20x larger.
raw.evidence: The current, denominator-matched per-window breakdown does not establish Chronos as the cheapest forecaster; parameter count alone cannot support that causal cost characterization.
raw.fix: Replace "cheapest forecaster" with "smallest forecaster by parameter count" and avoid inferring realized cost from model size.
